title: CSAMT data in Xingning area, Hunan Province, China

staged_protocol.stage_1: Inspect archive member names, directory structure, documentation, coordinates, source metadata, and acquisition settings without parsing response columns.
staged_protocol.stage_2_condition: Metadata must identify multiple independent survey lines or dates and expose receiver coordinates, transmitter endpoints or reconstructable geometry, source current and waveform, frequencies, response components, and uncertainty semantics.
staged_protocol.stage_2_role_rule: Freeze whole-line or whole-date roles before parsing any apparent-resistivity, phase, field-amplitude, or impedance values.
staged_protocol.abort_condition: Do not use the archive for formal CSAMT passage when it is a single worked example, lacks the complete observation contract, or cannot possibly support 223 effective test clusters.
